thread:
mira: Quick thought 1 about default saved-view 'apply' UX. If an org-default updates, do we force overwrite route-level views? Risk: unexpected quota/routing changes.

dan: Don't overwrite. Mark derived views with `inherited_from` and offer a one-click 'sync from default' with preview.

roger: Backend: add POST /views/:id/preview-impact returning per-route token/cost delta for a given window. Small example payload is enough for UI.

ui-bot: ui: I'll design a batched preview card showing top-3 impacted routes, total token delta, and an opt-in checkbox for "auto-sync".

sylvia: Safety rule: block auto-apply if delta >120% of historical peak unless admin confirms. Also emit telemetry events: view.previewed, view.synced, view.sync_blocked.

mira: Sounds good. I'll create a short ADR and schedule an infra + product sync to align on audit logs and rollback story.
